text_block_list.text:
Using the hot springs trip voucher won in 
the lottery earlier, I'm here with Nishino 
Flower...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Mom, Dad! Look, there's a huge pond over 
there!

text_block_list.name: Flower's Mother
text_block_list.text: Wah, you're right. It's so pretty.

Her parents had come along on the hot 
spring trip as well.

text_block_list.name: Flower's Father
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sorry we tagged along as well. 
Trainer, it must be hard to relax when the 
parents of the girl you're looking after 
are right here."
choice_data_list:
She's the one who should be letting her 
hair down, after all.

text_block_list.name: Flower's Father
text_block_list.text: ...! Thank you so, so much...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer, let's go to a hot spring!
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: That feels so refreshing... ♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Open-air baths are so much fun! That 
freezing-yet-steaming feeling is just like 
eating ice cream under a kotatsu♪"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Were you able to relax as well, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad♪
choice_data_list: By the way, where are your parents?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, she said she was heading back to her 
room first!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Both Mom and Dad were constantly fidgeting 
and worrying, wondering, "Aren't we being 
a bother to the Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
In the past, I'm sure I would have worried 
over it as well. However...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you won't think of it as a 
nuisance at all, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I told them how you cherish the people who 
are precious to me, and what a kind person 
you are!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...So, um.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: M-May I make a selfish request!?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...I want to eat ice cream with you after 
taking a bath.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, it's right before dinner, so 
I know I shouldn't, but...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Thinking about having ice cream under a 
kotatsu just made me crave some.
choice_data_list: Alright, should we sneak a bite?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Please♪ Keep it a secret from Mom and Dad, 
okay!

text_block_list.name: Flower's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"...To see her act so sweet and clingy. 
You really must be a wonderful Trainer to 
her."

text_block_list.name: Flower's Father
text_block_list.text: Ah...... My girl really is so blessed.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: —Mmh~, delicious...♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, would it be all right if I asked 
for one more selfish favor?"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Someday, when I get bigger... I want to 
come here with you again...♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Someday... Please make that promise 
with me!

It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond between myself and 
Nishino Flower...
